finding.summary: XSS in Bleach when noscript and raw tag whitelisted

verdict.reasoning: The application uses the vulnerable `bleach.clean` function with `strip=False` and includes 'noscript' in the allowed tags. The `render_note` function, which calls `bleach.clean`, is reachable from the entry point `save` in `notes/web.py`. An outside party can influence the input to this path through HTTP requests.

evidence.explanation: The vulnerable `bleach.clean` function is called with `strip=False` and includes 'noscript' in the allowed tags.
The `save` function, which calls `render_note`, is an entry point reachable via HTTP PUT requests.

reflection.critique: The application does not whitelist any raw tags other than 'noscript' and 'style', which are not considered RCDATA tags. Additionally, the advisory specifically mentions that the vulnerability requires both 'noscript' and one or more of the following raw tags to be whitelisted: title, textarea, script, style, noembed, noframes, iframe, xmp. Since none of these raw tags are included in the allowed tags list, the application does not meet the advisory's preconditions for the vulnerability.

package: bleach
summary: XSS in Bleach when noscript and raw tag whitelisted
affected: >=0, <3.1.1

GHSA-q65m-pv3f-wr5r (bleach) details:
### Impact

A [mutation XSS](https://cure53.de/fp170.pdf) affects users calling `bleach.clean` with `noscript` and a raw tag (see below) in the allowed/whitelisted tags option.

### Patches

v3.1.1

### Workarounds

* modify `bleach.clean` calls to not whitelist `noscript` and one or more of the following raw tags:

```
title
textarea
script
style
noembed
noframes
iframe
xmp
```

* A strong [Content-Security-Policy](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/CSP) without `unsafe-inline` and `unsafe-eval` [`script-src`s](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Headers/Content-Security-Policy/script-src)) will also help mitigate the risk.

GHSA-m6xf-fq7q-8743 (CVE-2020-6816)
package: bleach
summary: Bleach vulnerable to mutation XSS via whitelisted math or svg and raw tag
affected: >=0, <3.1.2

GHSA-m6xf-fq7q-8743 (bleach) details:
### Impact

A [mutation XSS](https://cure53.de/fp170.pdf) affects users calling `bleach.clean` with all of:

* the `svg` or `math` in the allowed/whitelisted tags
* an RCDATA tag (see below) in the allowed/whitelisted tags
* the keyword argument `strip=False`

### Patches

Users are encouraged to upgrade to bleach v3.1.2 or greater.

### Workarounds

* modify `bleach.clean` calls to use `strip=True`, or not whitelist `math` or `svg` tags and one or more of the following tags:

```
script
noscript
style
noframes
xmp
noembed
iframe
```

* A strong [Content-Security-Policy](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/CSP) without `unsafe-inline` and `unsafe-eval` [`script-src`s](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Headers/Content-Security-Policy/script-src)) will also help mitigate the risk.
